dispatch_rule: Do not create task 11 until at least one of tasks 1-10 materially closes, falsifies, or unblocks a project.

tasks.objective: Recover trustworthy real-host DB, queue, worker and failure state before creating new work.
tasks.evidence_requirement: Existing SQLite/WAL/process state, integrity result, backup hash, task counts, leases, heartbeats, PIDs/commands, provider/resource state; preserve failed runs.
tasks.verification_method: Independent SQLite recount plus process inspection; distinguish shell-only from active workers.
tasks.success_criterion: Real counters measured and state integrity/recovery truth established.
tasks.failure_criterion: Host unavailable or unrecoverable state remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; no large queue is created.

tasks.objective: Certify the exact immutable revision served by production.
tasks.deliverable: Passing production-health artifact with exact /api/health revision identity
tasks.evidence_requirement: Deployment identity, intended commit SHA, health body/header and retained monitor artifact.
tasks.verification_method: Canonical public production smoke monitor; Vercel status alone is insufficient.
tasks.success_criterion: Exact revision identity and public smoke boundaries pass.
tasks.failure_criterion: Missing/mismatched revision keeps production blocked; assertion is not weakened.

tasks.objective: Close manuscript provenance without new training.
tasks.evidence_requirement: Artifact IDs/hashes, exact commands, dataset identity, seeds, figure/table generation commands.
tasks.verification_method: Independent recomputation of manuscript numbers from retained raw metrics.
tasks.success_criterion: Every quantitative manuscript claim is traced or removed/flagged.
tasks.failure_criterion: Unreproducible number blocks the corresponding claim.

tasks.objective: Run originality audit and three skeptical reviewer attacks.
tasks.deliverable: ORIGINALITY_AUDIT.md plus novelty, experimental and mechanism reviewer reports
tasks.evidence_requirement: Verifiable closest literature and criticisms tied to the frozen protocol.
tasks.verification_method: Every criticism names severity, required evidence and cheapest decisive test.
tasks.success_criterion: Release contribution boundary and remaining gates are explicit.
tasks.failure_criterion: If too narrow, downgrade to technical report instead of rescue experimentation.

tasks.objective: Freeze the mixed/negative closure without touching reserved confirmatory seeds.
tasks.deliverable: Frozen claim ledger and failure taxonomy with successor separation rule
tasks.evidence_requirement: 5.33-5.36% development result, >=10% gate, Huber comparison and burst-failure evidence.
tasks.verification_method: Verify reserved seeds remain untouched and thresholds were not changed post-result.
tasks.success_criterion: v0.2 can be archived/published without ambiguity.
tasks.failure_criterion: Provenance gap blocks package; no new seeds are used to compensate.
tasks.canonical_artifact_destination: Existing IRIS evidence/manuscript path in control repo

tasks.objective: Preregister the learned direct-vs-IR and new-part-family OOD experiments.
tasks.deliverable: Two frozen executable protocols with baselines, metrics, compute matching, falsifiers and analysis plans
tasks.evidence_requirement: Preserve 19/20 vs 12/20 and O018 failure unchanged.
tasks.verification_method: Record protocol hashes/commits before result execution.
tasks.success_criterion: Both protocols are fair, executable and frozen.
tasks.failure_criterion: No fair comparator/OOD set means no broader claim is attempted.

tasks.objective: Run the most dangerous learned direct-generation baseline against typed/validated IR.
tasks.deliverable: Raw outputs, configs, runtime/cost, syntax/geometry/execution/semantic metrics and failure taxonomy
tasks.evidence_requirement: Same provider/model/task budget where feasible; preserve failed outputs.
tasks.verification_method: Independent parser/backend execution and metric recomputation.
tasks.failure_criterion: Baseline parity/win narrows or falsifies contribution and is preserved.

tasks.objective: Run frozen new-part-family OOD generalization test.
tasks.deliverable: Frozen OOD set, generated artifacts, executable results, error taxonomy, metrics and hashes
tasks.evidence_requirement: No post-hoc prompt substitution; all failed geometry retained.
tasks.verification_method: Independent OpenSCAD/backend execution and metric recomputation.
tasks.success_criterion: Predeclared OOD gate passes with interpretable failure rate.
tasks.failure_criterion: OOD collapse keeps research claim controlled/narrow or archives broader claim.

tasks.objective: Select exactly one Tier A science experiment by information gain and closure probability.
tasks.deliverable: Decision memo comparing T2424-0027 real encoder, Darcy learned/OOD and NPMS learned/OOD
tasks.evidence_requirement: Existing project evidence, dangerous baseline, cost and kill criterion for each candidate.
tasks.verification_method: Winner has a frozen protocol; two non-selected projects retain explicit states without duplicate tasks.
tasks.success_criterion: One winner or an explicit decision to leave the slot empty.
tasks.failure_criterion: No candidate has sufficient information gain, so no experiment runs.

tasks.objective: Package internally complete claims for bounded independent tests.
tasks.deliverable: Immutable artifact bundle and precise validator request for each eligible claim
tasks.evidence_requirement: Version/hash of sent package, requested action and returned evidence when available.
tasks.verification_method: Pending outreach remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; no GREEN on send.
tasks.success_criterion: Independent result is received and recorded with success/failure interpretation.
tasks.failure_criterion: Disagreement/non-reproduction narrows or blocks claim and is preserved.
